title: The Forgotten Vault
intro_text: Ancient conduits lie dormant beneath the obsidian vault. Power the neutral sockets with fragments to unlock the sealed exit gates.

levels.name: Conduit Awakening
levels.hint: The exit portal is sealed. Place a fragment onto the neutral socket to power the conduit and open the gate.

levels.name: The Vault Niche
levels.hint: The socket is tucked inside an alcove. Drop the fragment into the socket without trapping yourself in the corner.

levels.name: Conduit and Chasm
levels.hint: Two fragments: one must bridge the void to reach the generator, and one must remain in the socket to keep the exit open.

levels.name: Dual Conduits
levels.hint: Both sockets must remain active simultaneously. Place both fragments into their sockets and proceed to the portal.

levels.name: Vault Masterwork
levels.hint: A master arrangement combining two sockets, a void chasm, and three fragments. Power all circuits and cross to freedom.
